sentences.ar: الكابتن سمولت فتح الخريطة، بس نسخة بلا الصلبان الحمر.
sentences.en: Captain Smollett opened the map, but a copy without the red crosses.
And he asked Silver: do you know this island?
Silver said: certainly, captain.

sentences.ar: مرقت عليها مرة، مع سفينة تجار.
sentences.en: I passed it once, on a merchant ship.

sentences.ar: وحكى عن المرسى، وعن المي الحلوة، وعن الطقس.
sentences.en: And he told about the anchorage, the fresh water, the weather.

sentences.ar: وكان صوته دافي وضحوك، زي دايماً.
sentences.en: And his voice was warm and laughing, as always.

sentences.ar: وأنا واقف جنبه، وبدي أهرب من ريحة الكذب.
sentences.en: And I stood beside him, wanting to flee the smell of the lie.
When the deck emptied, I went to the doctor.

sentences.ar: قلت له: لازم أحكي معك بالكابينة.
sentences.en: I said to him: I must speak with you in the cabin.
We went down, with the squire and the captain.
And I told every word I had heard in the barrel.
When I finished, no one spoke.

sentences.ar: وبعدين قال الكابتن للسكوير: كنت معك حق.
sentences.en: And then the captain said to the squire: you were right.
I was wrong.
The squire said: no.

sentences.ar: إنت اللي كنت معك حق، وأنا الغبي.
sentences.en: You were the one who was right, and I the fool.
And this cook, I am the one who brought him.
The captain said: let us count.

sentences.ar: إحنا سبعة: تلاتة منكم، وأنا، وتلاتة من رجال السكوير.
sentences.en: We are seven: three of you, myself, and three of the squire's men.
And they are nineteen.
But surely not all are with him.
Some are hesitating.
The doctor said: and what do we do?

sentences.ar: قال الكابتن: منكمل زي ما إحنا.
sentences.en: The captain said: we go on as we are.
If we turn back now, they attack at once.
If we go on, they wait for the treasure.
And time is on our side.
The doctor said: and Jim?

sentences.ar: قال الكابتن: جيم أهم واحد فينا.
sentences.en: The captain said: Jim is the most important one among us.

sentences.ar: البحارة ما بيهتموا فيه، وهو بيسمع كل إشي.
sentences.en: The sailors pay him no attention, and he hears everything.

sentences.ar: يا جيم، خليك مع سيلفر زي قبل، وعينك مفتوحة.
sentences.en: Jim, stay with Silver as before, and keep your eyes open.
I said: aye, captain.
But in my heart I was very afraid.

sentences.ar: سبعة ضد تسعتعشر، وأنا واحد من السبعة.
sentences.en: Seven against nineteen, and I was one of the seven.
